581427515.accepts_evidence: New applicants check eligibility, pass an online eligibility quiz, register in the grantee portal and submit a letter of inquiry; LOIs are taken all year and reviewed on a rolling basis, and the foundation replies within about 60 days if it will invite a full application. https://www.leonlevinefoundation.org/how-to-apply/ and https://www.leonlevinefoundation.org/faqs/

581427515.deadlines: LOIs rolling, year-round. One LOI, and one operating or project application, per organization per foundation fiscal year (July 1 to June 30). 581427515.name: The Leon Levine Foundation
